verdict.rationale: Statsig's access-management docs cover SSO, SCIM, and auto-adding users by email domain, and they note that SCIM manages user accounts and permissions. That shows some user-access governance, but nothing shows control over who can change which flags. The Console API is documented for CRUD actions, but nothing indicates its keys can be scoped. Missing for 10: documented role definitions, per-flag or per-project change permissions, scoped or read-only API tokens, approval workflows, and independent corroboration.
